description:
Make the worktree identity that `jit init` records take its branch from the git module's head lookup, the one branch lookup every other consumer uses.

## Background

- `initialize_worktree_identity` (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:3336-3372`) runs `git branch --show-current` (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:3350`): a detached HEAD yields an empty string, an unborn branch yields its name, and a failure yields `main`. The CLI calls it after initialization is published (`crates/jit/src/main.rs:2013`).
- The head lookup reports a detached HEAD as `HEAD` and an unborn branch as no head.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The identity's branch is the head lookup's branch label for the paths' git checkout, and `main` on an unborn branch. `commands/mod.rs` starts no git process for it.
- [hard] REQ-02: Unit tests assert the behaviour change and fail on today's code: a detached checkout records `HEAD` (today an empty string), and a repository without commits on branch `trunk` records `main` (today `trunk`).

## Notes

- Behaviour change, limited to detached and commit-less repositories; every other recorded branch is unchanged.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Init records the worktree branch through the module
